findings.evidence: Lines 291–299 apply `SemimoduleCat.hom_ext`, replace the goal with an equality of `LinearMap.comp`/`TensorProduct.map` via `change`, then discharge it using `htensor`.
findings.fix: Use an explicit bridge lemma, or add a comment explaining why rewriting cannot expose the linear-map goal and which wrappers are being reduced.
findings.issue: `isMonoidal_of_linear_components` uses `change` after `SemimoduleCat.hom_ext` to identify categorical composition and tensoring with linear-map composition without documenting the required definitional reduction.

findings.evidence: Lines 316–320 apply `Units.ext`, use `change` to expose `Comodule.pointsAction = LinearMap.id`, and immediately rewrite the point-action lemmas.
findings.fix: Use a named coercion/extensionality lemma if available, or comment why `Units.ext` does not expose a rewriteable linear-map goal.
findings.issue: `ofLinearEquiv_pointsAction_tensorUnit_eq_one` uses `change` to reduce equality in `GeneralLinearGroup` to equality of underlying linear maps without documenting this definitional-equality dependency.

findings.evidence: Lines 351–356 extract `SemimoduleCat.Hom.hom`, rewrite two wrapper lemmas, then use `change` to obtain the `d.comp (TensorProduct.map ...) = ...comp d` equality.
findings.fix: Introduce an explicit conversion lemma or add a comment explaining why ordinary rewriting cannot reach this form and which definitional equalities are intended.
findings.issue: `distribBaseChange_comp_pointsAction` uses `change ... at hlin` to identify the underlying categorical tensor-hom equality with linear-map composition, again without documenting the wrapper reduction.

summary: Three new proofs use undocumented definitional-equality manipulation across categorical, unit, and linear-map wrappers.
